name: open-iptv-pro-tauri-experiment
description: Rust Lab v23.8.73: recently watched channel filter and  persisted revocable Discovery terms, per-import legal notice, DNS-pinned SSRF guard for remote playlists, catalog redirects and HLS segments; explicit legal-use confirmations before M3U import and Smart Discovery; responsive player layout without overlapping controls in narrow Mac windows, approved compact demo and three saved 1-32 dropdowns with working Rust timeshift; Quick Tools permanently open without blank volume cell; validated source selector regression and release CI; Electron-style real playback and Live AI controls, EPG, volume, source and FFmpeg; restore CC in fullscreen and native PiP with one synchronized WebVTT track; fix multiline CC word wrapping without text truncation, adapt font to video size; fully scrollable CC popup with non-clipped viewport portal, fullscreen support and corrected PiP CI test; one-click TTS enables Caption/Translate/TTS; turning Caption off disables all three, retaining classic WebView PiP and independent Live Caption toggle, pause/seek/stall-safe Whisper/TTS, shorter first speech chunks and prefetched WAV, segmented subtitle display/color/size/position controls; six selectable subtitle fonts with Chinese/Vietnamese fallback and live preview, lighter stroke weight, fixed release regression version; retain fast TTS and audio-synced caption overlays; independent Live Caption / Live Translate / TTS toggles, persistent choices, pause-safe speech; fix CI macOS release test, retain Argos and MLX translation features and eight real Hy-MT2/Qwen3 MLX models (Apple Silicon), on-demand local model install, resource-aware AI selection; source-aware direct Argos translation with no-op same-language TTS, persistent audio ducking and repeated-caption suppression; 25 VieNeu Vietnamese natural voices, 3 Piper voices, one-click offline install and previews; Electron v4.23.45 offline Live Caption, English translation, Piper/Argos voice-over, SHA-256 verified one-click local model installs
